U-Pick Items will include:
Strawberries
Blackberries
Raspberries
Cut Flowers
Pole Beans
Herbs
Peppers
We will also be selling cut flowers, beef, and value-added goods including olive oil and berry preserves. The last two events may also include a produce stand.

Bring your own basket/container to help us reduce waste! If you bring wicker, metal, or thick plastic, stop by the cashier before you head out to the field.

item.title: Cotati Accordion Festival — Sat Aug 15, 9:00 PM — Cotati Hub
item.description:
Two day international, multicultural, multi-generational non profit accordion festival with 90 vendors, five stages, 35 acts with food, wine and beer. The festival features the Zydeco Dance Party both days, the dancing in the 40′ x 60′ Polka tent, the Jam tent, the Apocalypse Stage for the alternative experience, and the two main stages featuring bands and soloists both local and from around the world. There is free parking and a free shuttle. Kids 15 and under are free when accompanied by an adult. In between acts the family can enjoy the large playground, the PSHS Wildlife Exhibit, face painting and possibly the return of the Sonoma County Children’s Museum. The musical genres flow through conjunto, Cumbia, jazz, rock, western, Balkan, classical, Klezmer, and even the United States Air Force band.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative, North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Thursday Sunset Paddle & Party at The Floathouse Petaluma — Thu Aug 20, 5:30 PM — The Floathouse Petaluma
item.description: Ease into the evening with a relaxed paddle on the Petaluma River, followed by dockside snacks and community time at The Floathouse Petaluma, right downtown in the central turning basin. No fuss, no stress, just community on the water with the sunset accompanying us. Once a month from April through September, paddlers gather for a 5:30 pm launch and head out together onto the calm tidal waters of the Petaluma River, right in the heart of downtown. As the seasons shift, the length of the paddle changes with the daylight—stretching into Sonoma County’s long summer evenings and shortening again as fall approaches. The group returns to the dock about 30 minutes before sunset, when everyone gathers to enjoy simple snacks, good conversation, and views of the evening sky over the river. Rent one of The Floathouse’s stable sit-on-top kayaks or stand-up paddleboards, or bring your own board or small boat and join the fun. item.title: If You Give A Mouse A Cookie — Sat Aug 22, 11:00 AM — Cinnabar Studio Space at the Petaluma Village Premium Outlets #700
item.description:
With a bag of cookies and a good spot in the yard to read his comic book, Boy was ready for a perfectly peaceful day. But then... Mouse came. He may be adorable, but he's full of questions. And energy. And he's hungry. What can Boy do but give Mouse a cookie? Wouldn't you do the same thing? But if you give a mouse a cookie, he's going to want a glass of milk...
Jody Davidson's adaptation, based on the books by Laura Joffe Numeroff, is a mayhem- and mishap-filled joyride for all audiences.

item.title: Party with a Purpose: Goatlandia invites the Community to "Reggae to the Rescue" — Sat Aug 22, 1:00 PM — Goatlandia Farm Animal Sanctuary
item.description: Sonoma County’s favorite reggae band, Sol Horizon, headlines Goatlandia’s biggest “fun-raising” celebration of the year! SEBASTOPOL, Calif. — Goatlandia Farm Animal Sanctuary & Education Center invites the community to trade the traditional black-tie gala for ﬂip-ﬂops, island colors, and good vibes at Reggae to the Rescue, its annual fundraising celebration, on Saturday, August 22, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. at the sanctuary’s beautiful 36-acre property in Sebastopol. VIP guests are welcomed from 1:00–2:00 p.m., with General Admission beginning at 2:00 p.m. and continuing through 5:00 p.m. The event brings together live music, rescued farm animals, delicious food and drinks, and a shared commitment to creating a more compassionate world. Headlining this year’s celebration is Sol Horizon, Sonoma County’s beloved reggae band, whose uplifting performances and loyal local following make them the perfect soundtrack for an unforgettable afternoon of community and compassion. item.title: If You Give A Mouse A Cookie — Sat Aug 29, 11:00 AM — Cinnabar Studio Space at the Petaluma Village Premium Outlets #700
item.description:
With a bag of cookies and a good spot in the yard to read his comic book, Boy was ready for a perfectly peaceful day. But then... Mouse came. He may be adorable, but he's full of questions. And energy. And he's hungry. What can Boy do but give Mouse a cookie? Wouldn't you do the same thing? But if you give a mouse a cookie, he's going to want a glass of milk...
Jody Davidson's adaptation, based on the books by Laura Joffe Numeroff, is a mayhem- and mishap-filled joyride for all audiences.
**Show details**
Authors: Adapted by Jody Davidson, based on the books by Laura Joffe Numeroff
Location: Cinnabar Theater Studio Space, 2200 Petaluma Blvd N., Suite 700, Petaluma
Performance dates: Sat Aug 22 (11am & 2pm), Sun Aug 23 (11am), Sat Aug 29 (11am & 2pm), Sun Aug 30 (11am)
Estimated run time: 60 minutes
Recommended for ages 3+. Children under 3 are welcome to attend at the discretion of their parent or caregiver. You know your child best! If your little one is ready for a live theate

item.title: Santa Rosa Open Studios Preview Exhibition Party — Wed Sep 2, 6:00 PM — The Finley Community Center
item.description:
The Santa Rosa Open Studios Preview Exhibition Party is the celebration wrapping up the SR Open Studios preview show that is on display at the Finley Center now! Artists who are part of the Santa Rosa Open Studios weekends have their art on display in one space.
The 9/2 party is an evening of art, great food and drink and music to kick off the 2026 Santa Rosa Open Studios. meet the participating artists, plan your itinerary, and purchase studio passports to use during your tour and enter into an art-inspired prize raffle!
Music by the Jack Gobetti Quartet \*featuring Lynne Morrow
Refreshments provided by The Spinster Sisters
\*Dress to impress, inspired by your favorite art or artist!
Source: Press Democrat

item.title: APA Pool League Game Night Extravaganza! — Wed Sep 2, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Apa Pool League Join us for an exciting evening of pool at the APA Pool League Night Extravaganza! Whether you are a seasoned pro or a beginner, this event is open to all players looking to have a fun time. Get ready to showcase your billiards skills, learn new strategies, and meet fellow pool enthusiasts. This is the perfect opportunity to socialize, enjoy friendly competition, and immerse yourself in the thrilling world of pool leagues.
Don't miss out on the chance to be part of the Apa Pool League community as we come together for a night filled with games, camaraderie, and good times. Whether you're interested in testing your skills, learning from others, or simply having a blast, this event has something for everyone. Grab your cue, chalk up your pool stick, and get ready for an unforgettable gaming experience with APA Pool League!
Source: Sonoma County APA Pool League
